name: Micro Center refurbished GeForce RTX 3090 / RTX 3090 Ti listing pages
notes: Live Micro Center category pages read 2026-10-03, product titles carry an explicit '(Refurbished)' suffix and each row shows a single 'Our price'. RTX 3090 24GB models (EVGA FTW3 Ultra, ASUS TUF/ROG Strix, MSI Suprim X/Ventus 3x, Gigabyte Gaming OC/Turbo/Vision/Eagle, PNY XLR8, Zotac Gaming Trinity, NVIDIA Founders Edition) all sit at exactly $1,099.99. RTX 3090 Ti 24GB (EVGA FTW3 Ultra/Black, ASUS TUF, MSI Suprim X) all sit at exactly $1,239.99. The perfectly flat pricing across every AIB is the notable fact: Micro Center treats refurb 3090 as a single price point per tier rather than pricing per board. 'BUY IN STORE' is present on every row, so this is a store-inventory channel.
